captions: IDLE: sensors fresh, waiting for the operator
Patrol: drive straight until the front ultrasonic reads under 0.50 m
Obstacle inside the stop band: turn towards the freer infrared side
Front clear above 0.70 m for 0.5 s: patrol resumes
A box placed against the front-left corner, 0.11 m from the infrared sensor
Infrared under 0.12 m: reverse until both corners read over 0.18 m
The robot boxed in on four sides
No free side: the avoidance episode runs past its 10 s limit
ALERT: STUCK. Zero velocity; only the operator can release it
The robot tipped onto its side (pose set in Gazebo)
ALERT: TIPPING, tilt over 30 deg from the IMU orientation
Collision threshold lowered to 2 m/s2 for the test (ros2 param set)
A strike from the left, outside the ultrasonic cone
ALERT: COLLISION, horizontal acceleration over the threshold twice
Threshold restored to 8 m/s2. Operator: reset
Range adapter node stopped while driving
ALERT: SENSOR_LOST, no range reading for 1 s
Goal sent on /goal_pose: A* over the costmap the robot built
Goal reached within 0.10 m: back to IDLE
